post.description: Creates a new branch commit from the provided component payload. Each component may include one or more files, and file contents must be supplied as Base64-encoded strings.

400.description: Invalid commit payload or incomplete component data.

404.description: The target branch or another required resource was not found.

500.description: Unexpected internal error while processing commits.

post.description: Creates a new pull request between the specified branches.

400.description: Invalid pull request payload, params, query, or headers.

403.description: You do not have permission to create pull requests.

404.description: Source or target branch was not found.

409.description: Pull request creation conflicts with existing branches or an existing pull request.

500.description: Unexpected internal error while processing pull requests.

409.description: A branch with the same name already exists or the requested branch state conflicts with current data.

parameters.name: types

parameters.name: statuses

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter by job creation date range — end of range (inclusive)

parameters.name: createdByIds
parameters.description: Filter by creator IDs. Semicolon-separated list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return
